title: An Exact Counting Formula for the Mutual Position of Two Plane Conics
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power, and $\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{D}$ be two smooth plane conics defined over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with transversal intersection. We present an exact formula for the number of points in $\mathbb{P}^2(\mathbb{F}_q)$ that are internal/external to $\mathcal{C}$ and internal/external to $\mathcal{D}$. This refines the $\frac{q^2}{4}+O(q^{3/2})$ asymptotic estimate for this quantity due to Asgarli and Yip \cite[Theorem 1.2]{Asgarli}.
